_note: manus2-space (The Lull, 2026-10-23): the SFX layer of a higgsfield01 rebuild. hf01's score does nearly all the work: no transition whooshes, a silent UI (no clicks, no pops), and a few dedicated sounds, each placed here in hf01's own slot (hf01-study/SOUND.md §3: U1-U8 title/UI, A1-A3 ambience, F1-F8 foley, V1 mascot, E1 sting = the score's hit), made true to a space story by the vacuum rule (in-suit sound only until the re-entry roar). Levels sit against the engine's music stem (style film, RMS about -10 dBFS); finish.py masters the sum.
